                [32m'- Status `400` with body `{"error": string}` when the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or empty, when `metric` is not a registered metric, when `value` is missing or is not a finite number, or when `recordedAt` is missing or is not a parsable ISO-8601 timestamp.                 [32m"- Any `id` or `ingestedAt` field supplied in the request body is untrusted and must never be used as the stored sample's identifier or ingestion timestamp.\n"[39m +
                [32m'- Concurrency invariant: when N requests carrying the same `Idempotency-Key` and the same body are issued simultaneously, exactly one of them returns `201`, all others return `200`, all of them return the same `id`, and exactly one sample ends up stored.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'`POST /api/rollup` — enqueue one rollup run. It must return status `202` with body `{"jobId": string, "jobName": "rollupMetrics"}` immediately, without waiting for the rollup to finish. The enqueued work item must carry the argument `{"reason": "manual"}`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m"`GET /api/dashboard` — status `200` with a JSON array holding exactly one object per registered metric, ordered by `metric` ascending, each object having exactly the keys `metric`, `count`, `p95`, `avg`, `delta` and `updatedAt`. The returned numbers must be exactly the values persisted by the most recent rollup of that metric; ingesting samples must never change this endpoint's output until a rollup has run. `updatedAt` is the UTC instant at which the rollup persisted that metric's result, formatted as an ISO-8601 string ending in `Z`. For a metric that has never been rolled up, return `count` `0` and `null` for `p95`, `avg`, `delta` and `updatedAt`.\n"[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### Rollup semantics\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m"One rollup run processes every registered metric. For a metric with at least one stored sample, let `T` be the greatest `recordedAt` among that metric's stored samples, and define:\n"[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'- current window: samples with `T - 3600s < recordedAt <= T`\n'[39m +
                [32m'- previous window: samples with `T - 7200s < recordedAt <= T - 3600s`\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'and persist:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `count`: the number of samples in the current window.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `avg`: the arithmetic mean of the current-window values, rounded to 3 decimal places, half away from zero.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `p95`: the nearest-rank 95th percentile of the current-window values, i.e. sort the current-window values ascending and take the value whose 1-based position is `ceil(0.95 * count)`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `delta`: `p95(current window) - p95(previous window)`, rounded to 3 decimal places, half away from zero, or `null` when the previous window contains no samples.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'For a registered metric with no stored samples at all, persist `count` `0` and `null` for `p95`, `avg` and `delta`. Every processed metric gets a fresh persisted timestamp on every run. Rollups must never delete or mutate raw samples.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### Background processing\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'The rollup work item is queued under the exact name `rollupMetrics`, so a work item with that name enqueued by any producer that talks to the app\'s queue — including one enqueued directly in the database by an external process while the app is running — must be picked up and executed by the running app. In addition, `rollupMetrics` must be registered as a recurring job with the cron expression `23 3 * * *` and the argument `{"reason": "cron"}`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### Dashboard page (port 3000)\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'The route `/` must render the dashboard, fetching its data from the server rather than embedding constants. For each registered metric it must render an element carrying the attribute `data-metric="<metric name>"`, and inside that element five descendant elements carrying `data-field="count"`, `data-field="p95"`, `data-field="avg"`, `data-field="delta"` and `data-field="updatedAt"`. Each of those five elements must contain the current value of that field as text, using exactly `-` as the text when the value is `null`.'[39m
            }

                      [32m'Background jobs in Wasp leverage the PgBoss job queue system, which uses PostgreSQL as the underlying storage and coordination mechanism.\n'[39m +

              input: {
                path: [32m'/home/user/waspmetrics/src/jobs.ts'[39m,
                content: [32m'function roundHalfAwayFromZero(num: number, decimals: number): number {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const factor = Math.pow(10, decimals);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const sign = Math.sign(num);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const absoluteValue = Math.abs(num);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const shifted = absoluteValue * factor;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const rounded = Math.round(Number((shifted).toFixed(12)));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return (sign * rounded) / factor;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export async function rollupMetrics(args: { reason?: string }, context: any) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  console.log(`Running rollupMetrics. Reason: ${args?.reason || 'unknown'}`);\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  const { Sample, RollupResult } = context.entities;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  const registeredMetrics = ['error_rate', 'latency_ms', 'queue_depth'];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  const now = new Date();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  for (const metric of registeredMetrics) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    // 1. Find the latest sample's recordedAt for this metric\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    const latestSample = await Sample.findFirst({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      where: { metric },\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      orderBy: { recordedAt: 'desc' }\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!latestSample) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      // No stored samples at all: persist count 0 and nulls\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      await RollupResult.upsert({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        where: { metric },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        create: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          metric,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          count: 0,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          p95: null,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          avg: null,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          delta: null,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          updatedAt: now\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        update: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          count: 0,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          p95: null,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          avg: null,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          delta: null,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          updatedAt: now\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      continue;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const T = latestSample.recordedAt;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const currentWindowStart = new Date(T.getTime() - 3600 * 1000);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const currentWindowEnd = T;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const previousWindowStart = new Date(T.getTime() - 7200 * 1000);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const previousWindowEnd = currentWindowStart;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Fetch current window samples sorted ascending by value\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const currentSamples = await Sample.findMany({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      where: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        metric,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        recordedAt: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          gt: currentWindowStart,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          lte: currentWindowEnd\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      },\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      orderBy: { value: 'asc' }\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Fetch previous window samples sorted ascending by value\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const previousSamples = await Sample.findMany({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      where: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        metric,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        recordedAt: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          gt: previousWindowStart,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          lte: previousWindowEnd\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      },\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      orderBy: { value: 'asc' }\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const count = currentSamples.length;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let avg: number | null = null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let p95: number | null = null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let delta: number | null = null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (count > 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const sum = currentSamples.reduce((acc: number, s: any) => acc + s.value, 0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      avg = roundHalfAwayFromZero(sum / count, 3);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const p95Index = Math.ceil(0.95 * count) - 1;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      p95 = currentSamples[p95Index].value;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const prevCount = previousSamples.length;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (prevCount > 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const prevP95Index = Math.ceil(0.95 * prevCount) - 1;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const prevP95 = previousSamples[prevP95Index].value;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        delta = roundHalfAwayFromZero(p95 - prevP95, 3);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    await RollupResult.upsert({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      where: { metric },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      create: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        metric,\n'[39m +

                  [32m'        delta,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        updatedAt: now\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +

                  [32m"  const idempotencyKey = req.get('Idempotency-Key');\n"[39m +
                  [32m"  if (!idempotencyKey || idempotencyKey.trim() === '') {\n"[39m +

                  [32m"    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid or missing metric' });\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  if (value === undefined || value === null || typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) {\n"[39m +

                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  if (!recordedAt || typeof recordedAt !== 'string') {\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'recordedAt is missing or invalid' });\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const parsedDate = Date.parse(recordedAt);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (isNaN(parsedDate)) {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  const existing = await Sample.findUnique({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    where: { idempotencyKey }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
